REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

 

Country: Republic of Tajikistan

Project: Strengthening Resilience Agricultural Sector Project

Grant No.: E1450-TJ 

Assignment Title: Consulting Services for Practical Training on Agricultural Drone Operations, Multispectral Data Acquisition and Processing for the Agriculture Technical Team (ATT)

Reference No. (as per Procurement Plan): SRASP-CS-RFP-2026-01

  1. The Republic of Tajikistan has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the “Strengthening Resilience of the Agriculture Sector Project” additional financing and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services. 

The State Institute “Agriculture Entrepreneurship Development” now invites eligible consulting firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services.

 

2. The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be found at the following website:

https://ehukumat.tj/uploads/2026/10/20/6d930c69cd233bb8346fd4277b38f10f_original.244861.pdf

3. The State Institute “Agriculture Entrepreneurship Development” now invites eligible consulting firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. The criteria for selecting the Consultant are:

4. The Training provider shall be a firm with proven experience in similar assignments including (but not limited to) Expertise in the following:   

  • documented experience operating professional UAV systems
  • practical experience with agricultural or multispectral UAV surveys
  • experience in RGB and multispectral image processing
  • knowledge of photogrammetry
  • experience with vegetation indices such as NDVI and NDRE
  • experience with GIS software
  • knowledge of RTK/GNSS positioning
  • experience delivering practical UAV training
  • capacity to conduct field-based training in the Republic of Tajikistan.

Experience with DJI Mavic 3 Multispectral, DJI Terra, precision agriculture, Sentinel-2 imagery or agricultural remote sensing shall be considered an advantage.

 

The above experience shall be demonstrated through a list of similar projects/contracts, including, at a minimum: description of services provided, contract amount, name of the contractor/client, project location/country, duration, assignment budget, and percentage of completion.

Where applicable, the submission shall also specify the Consultant’s role in joint ventures or sub consultancy arrangements, as well as the Consultant’s core business activities.

In addition, the above information shall be supported by certificates of completion or other documentary evidence confirming satisfactory performance, duly verified by the respective counterparties to the contracts concerned.

5. The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to paragraph 3.14, 3.16 and 3.17 of the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers (July 2016, revised in September 2023) Procurement in Investment Project Financing Goods, Works, Non-Consulting and Consulting Services (“the Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

6. The selection of consultants will be conducted using the Consultant Qualification Selection (CQS) method, in accordance with the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers (July 2016, revised in September 2023) Procurement in Investment Project Financing Goods, Works, Non-Consulting and Consulting Services.

7. Further information can be obtained at the address below during office hours from 08:00 to 17:00.

8. Expressions of interest in Russian or English must be delivered in a written form to the address below (in person, or by mail, or by fax, or by e-mail) by November 05, 2026, 12:00 a.m.

State Institution “Agriculture Entrepreneurship Development” Project Management Unit

Attn: Satori D.A. - PMU Director

Address: Bokhtar street 17, 12th Floor       

City: Dushanbe

Country: Tajikistan

E-mail: procurement.srasp@gmail.com

ADMINISTRAÇÃO NACIONAL DE ESTRADAS, IP

Departamento de Aquisições

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

(CONSULTING SERVICES - FIRMS SELECTION)

Country:                    Mozambique

Name of Project:      Climate Resilient Roads for the North (CRRN - P500488)

Grant No.:                 E315-MZ

Assignment Title:     Consultancy Services for Supervision of the Construction of Substructures and Installation of Metallic Bridges in Nampula province.

Reference No:           47A003041/CP/33/2026

Client:                        National Road Administration, Administração Nacional de Estradas, Instituto                            Publico (ANE, IP)

1. The Government of Mozambique (GOM) has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Climate Resilient Roads for the North (CRRN), and intends to apply part of the proceeds for Consultancy Services for Supervision of the Construction of Substructures and Installation of Metallic Bridges in Nampula province hereafter designated the “Services”.

2. The project development objective is to improve climate-resilient road connectivity in the Northern provinces of Mozambique. The construction and installation of the above-mentioned bridges will be implemented over a period of 10 months. The works are expected to be packaged in lots considering differences in their locations.

3. The consulting services include but not limited to the following:

a) Review of detailed engineering designs, construction drawings and quantities prepared by the Design Consultant.

b) Supervision of the contractors works for construction of the substructures and installation of 7 metallic bridges in Nampula Province.

c) Inspection, monitor defects correction and complete contract closure during Defects Notification Period for construction of substructures and installation of metallic bridges.

4. The detailed Terms of Reference (ToR) for the assignment can be obtained through the link:  https://www.fe.gov.mz/storage/app/uploads/public/6ad/876/11e/6ad87611e63dc946883810.pdf, or alternatively at the address below.

5. The National Road Administration, Administração Nacional de Estradas, Instituto Público (ANE, IP) now invites eligible consulting firms (“Consultants”) to express their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services.

6. The evaluation of expressions of interest will be made on qualitative basis and the short-listing criteria are:

a) General experience of the firm (must be at least 15 years) in the field of bridge design and supervision;

b) Description of at least three (3) successfully completed similar projects involving construction supervision or design review of metallic bridges in the last ten years;

c) Proved Technical and managerial capability of the firm;

d) Experience of working in Sub Saharan Africa in the last 5 years is an added advantage;

e) Experience in fragility, conflict, and violence affected countries is an added advantage;

    The CVs of the experts will not be evaluated at the shortlisting stage.

7. The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs, 3.13, 3.15, and 3.16 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” September 2025 (“Procurement Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

8. Consultants may associate with other firms to enhance their qualifications but should indicate clearly whether the association is in the form of a joint venture and/or a sub-consultancy. In the case of a joint venture, all the partners in the joint venture shall be jointly and severally liable for the entire contract, if selected.

9. A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Quality and Cost-Based Selection (QCBS) method set out in the Procurement Regulations.

10. Further information can be obtained at the address below during office hours, from 07:30 - 15:30 hours local time, Mondays to Fridays, except Public Holidays:

11. Expressions of interest in English language, clearly marked RFP Nº 47A003041/CP/33/2026 “Consultancy Services for Supervision of the Construction of Substructures and Installation of Metallic Bridges in Nampula province” must be delivered in a written form to the address below (in person, by mail, or by e-mail) by 15:00 hours (local time), of November 13, 2026.

Expression of Interest for short term Consultancy of Finance Officers (2)

 

COUNTRY:               Kingdom of Lesotho

PROJECT:                Lesotho Education Improvement Project (LEIP)

SECTOR:                   Education

LOAN #:                     7587-LS

PROJECT ID NO.:   P500587

 

The Government of the Lesotho (GOL) signed Loan with World Bank to support implementation of the Lesotho Education Improvement project (P500587) (LEIP) for a total value of US$ 20 million in August 2024.  The project aims to improve basic education service delivery and student retention in targeted schools. Mainly construction of classrooms and pit latrines in primary schools, and workshop, science laboratory blocks and latrines in secondary schools is included in the project. MoET intends to apply part of the proceeds to payments for goods, related services and consulting services to be procured under this project.

 

The three components of the project are:

 

Component 1: Improving the quality of teaching in primary and secondary schools

 

Component 2: Enhancing physical learning conditions in targeted primary and secondary schools, (I) Improving basic infrastructure in targeted primary schools, (II) Constructing laboratories and workshops in targeted secondary schools with the total allocation of US$ 15 Million.

 

Component 3: Strengthening project management, and governance of education system.

 

The Ministry of Education and Training (MOET) now wishes to recruit a Two (2) Finance Officers to be part of the Project Facilitation Unit (PFU) which is responsible for facilitating the implementation of the project.

 

 

 

Objective:

The principal objective of this assignment is the provision of consulting services for finance officer to support project financial, accounting management and reporting.

 

Qualification and Experience:

Interested candidates must have:

  1. Educational qualifications: at least Diploma in Accounting/Business or CAT Stage or CIPFA-Diploma from a recognized University or Professional Institution respectively, bachelor’s degree/General Accounting Stage will be an added advantage.
  2. Work Experience: Be familiar with Government of Lesotho and donor funded projects Financial Management and must have at least successfully completed one (1) similar assignment in the past Seven (7) years.

 

Selection Criteria:

The selection of the suitable candidate will be based on the qualifications and experience as follows: (i) qualifications (30%), (ii) experience (professional, specific and general) (60%); and (iii) other relevant attributes (10%)consistent with the requirements of the Terms of Reference pursuant to the relevant requirements of the World Bank’s applicable Guidelines: Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers July 2016 and updated February 2025 (Sixth Edition), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest available on www.worldbank.org/procurement.

 

 

Duration:

The duration of this assignment will be approximately from 6 months with possibility of extension subject to satisfactory performance.

Details:

Detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) can be attained from the following address between 8:00 a.m. and 4:30 p.m. on working days: Procurement Unit, EFU, Site 130 Fokothi, Off Moshoeshoe Road, P.O. Box 1279, Maseru 100, Lesotho. Tel (+266) 22324968. Attn:  Mr. Relebohile Nkalai Email: relebohile.nkalai@gov.ls  with a copy to nthabi.hleoheng86@gmail.com .

 

Submission:

Interested consultants should submit their detailed expression of interest and updated Curriculum Vitae (CVs), indicating names and contact details of at least two (2) referees, and should enclose certified copies of educational certificates. The Expression of interest must be hand delivered to the address indicated above on or before May 05th, 2026, at 4:30 p.m. (local time).

 

Submissions must be clearly titled (including on the submission envelope where applicable): “Expression of Interest for Finance Officer)’’

SOLLICITATION DE MANIFESTATIONS D’INTERET SELECTION DE CONSULTANTS PAR LES EMPRUNTEURS DE LA BANQUE MONDIALE

 

NOM DU PAYS : Mali

NOM DU PROJET : Projet d’Harmonisation et d’Amélioration des Statistiques en Afrique de l’Ouest et du Centre (PHASAOC)

SERVICE DE CONSULTANTS : « Services de consultant pour la refonte du site web de l’Institut National de la Statistique (INSTAT) »

Crédit : n° 73120

 

No. de référence : activité N° ML PHASAOC-533341-CS-CQS du PPM  (services de consultants)                                            

                                                                                               A

                                       Monsieur le Directeur  d’EMEX SARL , Kalaban          

                                       Coura pres de la mairie Immeuble Moussa Keita   

                                       email : emes.sarl0223@gmail.com Nif: 085154979J

                                       Tel : 92 93 38 10 Bamako-Mali

 

Le Gouvernement de la République du Mali a obtenu un Crédit de l’Association Internationale pour le Développement en différentes monnaies, pour financer le coût du Projet d’Harmonisation et d’Amélioration des Statistiques en Afrique de l’Ouest et du Centre. Il est prévu qu’une partie des sommes accordées au titre de ce Crédit sera utilisée pour effectuer les paiements prévus au titre du contrat suivant : Services de consultant pour la refonte du site web de l’Institut National de la Statistique (INSTAT) »

Les services de consultant (« Services ») comprennent : Sous la supervision du DADD, le cabinet réalisera les tâches suivantes :

 Phase 1 : Analyse des besoins et diagnostic : (i) analyser les besoins spécifiques de l’INSTAT, (ii) analyser l’existant en matière de présence web, de gestion de contenu et d’infrastructures numériques de l’INSTAT, (iii) identifier les besoins fonctionnels et techniques pour la mise en place de la plateforme web et (iv) élaborer un rapport d’analyse des besoins et le soumettre à l’INSTAT pour validation.

Phase 2 : Conception technique et fonctionnelle : (i) proposer une architecture technique, fonctionnelle, robuste et sécurisée, (ii) élaborer les maquettes fonctionnelles (interfaces et navigation) de la plateforme, (iii) organiser des sessions de présentation des maquettes avec l’INSTAT, (iv) intégrer les observations et produire une version validée et (v) élaborer un cahier des charges technique détaillé.

Phase 3 : Développement de la plateforme : (i) développer le site web (plateforme) conformément aux maquettes validées, (ii) développer le site en conformité avec les normes de sécurité et d’interopérabilité, (iii) développer et intégrer les fonctionnalités de gestion de contenu et de visualisation de données (tableaux de bord), (iv) réaliser les tests fonctionnels, techniques ainsi que des tests de sécurité nécessaires et (v) effectuer les corrections et améliorations suite aux tests.

Phase 4 : Déploiement et formation : (i) assurer le déploiement et la mise en ligne du site web, (ii) assurer l’hébergement et la configuration technique initiale de la plateforme, (iii) organiser des sessions de formation au profit des utilisateurs désignés de l’INSTAT et (iv) former les utilisateurs à la gestion éditoriale et technique ainsi qu’à l’administration de la plateforme.

Phase 5 : Accompagnement et finalisation : (i) produire un manuel d’utilisation, (ii) produire un manuel d’administration, (iii) finaliser les ajustements techniques nécessaires, (iv) effectuer les tests de sécurité de la plateforme dans son environnement de production et (v) produire un rapport final de mission.

La durée totale de la mission est de six (06) mois.

 

Le Directeur de l’Institut National de la Statistique (INSTAT) invite les firmes de consultants (« Consultants ») admissibles à manifester leur intérêt à fournir les services décrits ci-dessus. Les Consultants intéressés doivent fournir les informations démontrant qu’ils possèdent les qualifications requises et une expérience pertinente pour l’exécution des Services. Les critères pour l’établissement de la liste restreinte sont : Cette mission sera conduite par un cabinet

spécialisé dans le développement de solutions numériques et de plateformes digitales avec au moins trois (3) ans d’expérience dans le développement de plateformes digitales, avoir une expérience antérieure avec des projets similaires et une expérience dans la création de tableaux de bord.

 

Il est porté à l’attention des Consultants que les dispositions du paragraphe 3.32 du « Règlement de passation des Marchés pour les Emprunteurs sollicitant le financement de Projets d’Investissement (FPI) de juillet 2016 », révisé en novembre 2017, juillet 2018, novembre 2020, septembre 2023, février 2025 et septembre 2025 relatives aux règles de la Banque mondiale en matière de conflit d’intérêts sont applicables. Veuillez noter les dispositions additionnelles suivantes relatives au conflit d’intérêts dans le cadre des services objet de la présente Sollicitation de manifestation d’intérêt : (i) conflit entre les activités de consultant et la fourniture de biens, de travaux ou de services (autres que les services de consultants couverts par les présentes Directives), (ii) conflit entre les missions de conseil et (iii) relation avec le personnel de l’Emprunteur.

Un Consultant sera sélectionné selon la méthode de Sélection Fondée sur les Qualifications du Consultant (SQC) telle que décrite dans le nouveau règlement de passation des marchés des emprunteurs de la Banque mondiale de juillet 2016 », révisé en novembre 2017, juillet 2018, novembre 2020, septembre 2023, février 2025 et septembre 2025

Les Consultants intéressés peuvent obtenir des informations supplémentaires tous les jours ouvrables de 8 H 00 à 16 H 00 heures locales.

 

Les manifestations d’intérêt écrites doivent être déposées sous la mention « Manifestation d’intérêt pour les Services de consultant pour la refonte du site web de l’Institut National de la Statistique (INSTAT) » à l’adresse ci-dessous en personne, par courrier, par facsimile ou par courrier électronique au plus tard le 26 Août 2026 à 10 H 00.

Phase 2 : Conception technique et fonctionnelle : (i) proposer une architecture technique, fonctionnelle, robuste et sécurisée, (ii) élaborer les maquettes fonctionnelles (interfaces et navigation) de la plateforme, (iii) organiser des sessions de présentation des maquettes avec l’INSTAT, (iv) intégrer les observations et produire une version validée et (v) élaborer un cahier des charges technique détaillé.

INSTITUTO NACIONAL DE ESTATÍSTICA

PROJECTO DE ESTATÍSTICAS REGIONAIS DA SADC

CONVITE PARA A MANIFESTAÇÃO DE INTERESSE

CONSULTOR INDIVIDUAL

REGIME ESPECIAL

PAÍS: MOÇAMBIQUE

Fonte de Financiamento: Grant E2700

Projecto: P175731

Refª: MZ-INE-570603-CS-INDV

CONTRATAÇÃO DE CONSULTOR EM DESENVOLVIMENTO, POPULAÇÃO E POLÍTICAS SOCIAIS

  1. O Instituto Nacional de Estatística (INE) recebeu uma subvenção da Associação Internacional de Desenvolvimento (AID), instituição do Banco Mundial, para a implementação do Projecto Regional de Estatísticas da SADC (PRESADC), e pretende aplicar parte dos fundos para a contratação de um Consultor Individual – Especialista em Desenvolvimento, População e Políticas Sociais, para apoiar a Direcção Nacional de Políticas Económicas e Desenvolvimento (DNPED) do Ministério da Planificação e Desenvolvimento (MPD).
  2. Os serviços de consultoria (“Serviços”) visam apoiar a DNPED na concepção, realização e divulgação de estudos que produzam evidências para a formulação e o aperfeiçoamento da política económica e de desenvolvimento, tendo em conta a dinâmica demográfica, a aceleração da transição demográfica e as condições para o aproveitamento do dividendo demográfico, com recurso prioritário aos dados do Sistema Estatístico Nacional, em co-produção com os técnicos da DNPED e assegurando a transferência de conhecimentos. Mais detalhes sobre os serviços e as responsabilidades da consultoria encontram-se nos Termos de Referência (TdR).
  3. Os requisitos mínimos de qualificação são: Mestrado em Economia, Demografia, Estatística, Economia do Desenvolvimento, Políticas Públicas, Estudos de Desenvolvimento ou área relacionada; mínimo de 8 (oito) anos de experiência profissional relevante em economia do desenvolvimento, demografia, políticas sociais, investigação aplicada ou áreas relacionadas; e domínio da língua portuguesa. Serão ainda avaliados: estudos aplicados em dinâmica, transição e dividendo demográfico; estudos sobre pobreza, desigualdade ou capital humano com microdados de inquéritos; análise quantitativa (Stata, R, Python ou equivalente); notas de política e comunicação a órgãos de decisão; capacitação e transferência de conhecimentos; e experiência em Moçambique, no sector público ou em organizações internacionais.
  4. O Contrato terá duração de 12 (doze) meses, a partir da data de celebração do contrato, com base na DNPED, em Maputo.
  5. Os candidatos interessados e com o perfil requerido deverão submeter os seguintes documentos: Carta de Manifestação de Interesse, assinada; Curriculum Vitae actualizado e assinado, em língua portuguesa; cópias dos diplomas ou certificados de habilitações académicas (graus estrangeiros com a respectiva equivalência); comprovativos da experiência declarada (estudos, relatórios, notas de política, declarações das entidades contratantes ou referências verificáveis); e contactos de três (3) referências profissionais.
  6. As candidaturas deverão ser entregues até às 15:00 horas do dia 05 de Novembro de 2026 no endereço Instituto Nacional de Estatística – Avenida 24 de Julho nº1989, Piso 09- Sala 0901, Cidade de Maputo. Email: presadc.concursos@gmail.com
  7. O consultor será seleccionado de acordo com os procedimentos do Banco Mundial definidos no Regulamento de Aquisições para Mutuários de Operações de Financiamento de Projectos de Investimento, 6.ª edição, Fevereiro de 2025, particularmente os parágrafos 7.36 – 7.37 sobre Selecção de Consultores Individuais. Os interessados devem prestar particular atenção na Secção III, parágrafos 3.15 a 3.17 do mesmo Regulamento, política sobre conflito de interesse. Funcionários públicos e agentes do Estado só poderão ser contratados nas condições e casos excepcionais previstos no referido Regulamento.
  8. Os Termos de Referência e outros detalhes sobre a consultoria poderão ser obtidos no endereço acima e também estão disponíveis em www.ine.gov.mz/concursos. Somente o candidato melhor classificado será convidado para a negociação dos honorários e das condições do contrato.

19 de Outubro de 2026

procnotices.notice_text:
REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

(CONSULTING SERVICES – INDIVIDUAL SELECTION)

Country:   Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia

Name of Project: Eastern Africa Regional Digital Integration Project (EARDIP)

Project ID: P180931

Assignment Title: Recruitment of 3(Three) Senior Full-Stack Software Engineers for Optimization of Ethiopian eServices Platform.

Reference No.: ET-MINT-570555-CS-INDV

  1. Background

The Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Easter Africa Regional Digital Integration Project (EARDIP) and intends to apply part of the proceeds for the services of hiring qualified and experienced professionals to work as part of the Project Implementation Unit (PIU) for Easter Africa Regional Digital Integration Project established under Ministry of Innovation and Technology (MInT). MInT want to hire qualified and experienced enior Full-Stack Software Engineers for Optimization of Ethiopian eServices Platform.

2. Objective

The overarching objective of this consultancy assignment is to source, embed, and utilize top-tier technical professionals to ensure the successful delivery, scaling, and maintenance of national e-Government services and their associated public infrastructure modules. In alignment with the current national digital strategy, Digital Ethiopia 2030, these experts will spearhead the modernization of public service delivery by strictly adhering to international digital government benchmarks. This includes the systematic implementation of mobile and API-first architectures, cloud-native approaches, open-source technologies, and deep interoperability frameworks rooted in user-centered service design.

3. Main Responsibilities

The Senior Full-Stack Software Engineers will take complete technical ownership of the engineering lifecycle governing the nation's e-Government platforms. They will lead active coding sprints, define microservice patterns, manage versioning branches, and ensure the absolute operational continuity of public-facing live systems.

Their detailed responsibilities include:

3.1.1 Defining Optimization and Establishing a Baseline

  • Conduct Current-State Assessments: Perform an initial assessment of the existing platform to establish an architectural baseline and build a unified consensus with MInT on optimization priorities before prescribing future modernizations.  
  • Formulate a Quantifiable KPI Framework: Support MInT in defining and formalizing and defining the optimization of KPIs through a clear taxonomy, setting precise data sources and evaluation frequencies to transform broad optimization goals into measurable technical metrics.
  • Collaborate, Define, and Track Key Indicators: Collaborate with MInT stakeholders to establish baseline performance metrics and directly define, implement, and track key platform optimization indicators—including transaction processing times, online application completion rates, system availability, and transaction success rates.
  • Embed Institutional Sustainability and Knowledge Transfer: Integrate structured mentoring, paired-working arrangements, and continuous knowledge sharing into daily baseline activities to prepare MInT technical staff for long-term platform ownership.

Concrete Deliverable: Knowledge Transfer and Institutional Sustainability Package

To ensure knowledge transfer is a defined, measurable output rather than a generalized activity, the following tangible assets must be delivered:

  • Technical Training Artifacts & Delivery: Development and execution of practical technical training sessions for MInT developers and operational staff, accompanied by training materials, code walkthroughs, and recorded sessions covering system architecture, deployment environments, and operational workflows.
  • Comprehensive System Documentation Suite: Delivery of an up-to-date, centralized technical repository containing architecture diagrams, database schemas, API specifications, automated deployment procedures, configuration maps, troubleshooting guides, and operational runbooks.
  • Structured Mentoring & Competency Log: Implementation of a paired-programming and co-engineering schedule with designated MInT technical counterparts, validated by a brief competency sign-off log documenting the shared handling of system tasks.
  • Formal Platform Handover & Control Transfer: A verified handover package ensuring that all source code, deployment artifacts, infrastructure configurations, and administrative access controls are fully transferred to, and natively managed under, MInT's exclusive infrastructure control.

3.1.2 Full-Stack Architectural Design and Feature Development

  • Lead the comprehensive end-to-end design, system modeling, backend programming, and frontend user-interface construction of new modules within transactional e-Government applications.
  • Develop modular, reusable, and testable components, ensuring strict separation of concerns and adherence to international clean-coding standards.
  • Provide technical support, routine maintenance, and immediate bug-fixing for existing live public-facing platforms to ensure zero service disruption.
  • Construct dynamic, cross-browser compatible, and mobile-responsive frontend user experiences that match modern public design systems.
  • Design and execute highly efficient database schemas, indexing strategies, and raw query optimizations for complex enterprise relational and non-relational storage layers.
  • Optimize application performance, scalability, and code quality while ensuring integration with national digital ID and payment gateways.

3.1.3 Foundational National System Integrations

  • Architect and program secure, low-latency RESTful and gRPC API channels to connect e-Government applications directly with the national single sign-on (SSO) and the Fayda National Digital ID ecosystem.
  • Integrate multi-channel fintech infrastructures into the core, allowing real-time, verified payment processing across commercial banks, electronic wallets, and state-backed payment clearings.
  • Implement secure data exchange protocols (including tokenization and cryptographic signing) to safely transmit cross-ministry records without compromising data integrity or privacy.

3.1.4 Platform Maintenance, Optimization, and Zero-Disruption Support

  • Take immediate accountability for the active, live production environment of public e-services, minimizing downtime through preventative server-side optimization and resource scaling.
  • Provide immediate, tier-3 diagnostic support and rapid bug-fixing routines for errors identified by public citizens, civil servants, or automated monitoring frameworks.
  • Implement containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and orchestrate deployments via Kubernetes clusters to support zero-downtime rolling upgrades and automatic failure recoveries.
  • Configure automated application performance management (APM) systems and centralized logging pipelines to track error conditions and system bottlenecks in real-time.

3.1.5 Code Quality, Governance, and Sustainable Knowledge Transfer

  • To guarantee long-term state capacity and institutional sustainability, the consultancy team shall treat knowledge transfer not merely as an ongoing activity, but as a defined, verifiable project output. The consultants shall establish strict engineering governance and execute the following structured mandates:
  • Rigorous Peer Review & Branch Governance: Establish and enforce rigorous peer code review processes, requiring all engineering branch merges to satisfy strict security protocols, comprehensive test coverage baselines, and mandatory documentation updates before production deployment.
  • Comprehensive System Documentation & Runbooks: Draft, maintain, and publish complete technical system documentation under version control. This must include comprehensive architecture diagrams, database schemas, interactive API specifications (e.g., Swagger/OpenAPI), deployment configurations, troubleshooting guides, and step-by-step operational runbooks.
  • Practical Technical Training Sessions: Develop and deliver practical, structured technical training sessions and deep-dive code walkthroughs for MInT developers and designated technical staff. Training must thoroughly cover the optimized application architecture, the core codebase, cloud deployment environments, and daily operational procedures.
  • Structured Counterpart Mentoring: Establish a practical, daily mentoring and paired-working arrangement with designated MInT technical counterparts throughout the duration of the assignment to systematically build internal engineering capabilities.
  • Absolute Handover & MInT Control: Execute a formal, documented handover process ensuring that all source code repositories, deployment artifacts, technical documentation, configuration keys, and operational knowledge are fully transferred to, verified by, and maintained under MInT’s absolute institutional control.

4. Required Technical Competencies and Experience

4.1 Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer Profiles (Core Team Structure)

Candidates submitted for evaluation under these profiles must explicitly demonstrate a mature engineering pedigree, characterized by a history of shipping scalable, secure, and production-proven web applications. Rather than maintaining uniform generalist responsibilities, the consultancy team shall be deployed across three distinct areas of deeper technical focus while sharing a unified engineering core.

4.1.1 The Cross-Functional Collaboration Framework (Explicit Relationships)

To ensure the elimination of traditional development silos, all three engineering profiles must execute tight, continuous synchronization with separate Business Analyst and UX/UI design functions through the following defined responsibilities:

  • Requirement Translation: Collaborate closely with external UX/UI designers and Business Analysts to seamlessly translate citizen, business, and government user requirements into scalable, secure technical solutions.
  • Iterative Usability Optimization: Actively participate in iterative usability testing cycles and systematically incorporate user feedback into platform and service code improvements.
  • Pre-Automation Process Simplification: Partner directly with Senior Business Analysts to map administrative government workflows, transform complex functional rules into clean technical requirements, and support process simplification before writing automated code.

4.1.2 Professional Experience

  • Continuous Pedigree: A minimum of five (5) years of continuous, verifiable, and direct hands-on professional software development experience within production-grade environments.
  • Domain Relevance: Demonstrated experience working on large-scale web systems, public e-Government engines, or comparable high-volume transactional environments (such as core banking, digital payment switches, fintech networks, or telecommunications platforms).
  • Targeted Implementation Expertise: Candidates must explicitly demonstrate a mature, production-proven background across the following operational domains directly relevant to this assignment:
    • High-Availability Systems: Designing, scaling, and maintaining large-scale, fault-tolerant production systems with a history of ensuring continuous service reliability under high concurrency.
    • Legacy Modernization: Modernizing, refactoring, and decomposing legacy, monolithic software architectures into cloud-native microservices or modular frameworks.
    • API and Systems Integration: Orchestrating advanced API design and deep systems integration frameworks over diverse, heterogeneous data environments.
    • Database Engineering: Executing advanced database design, data modeling, index tuning, caching mechanisms, and rigorous query performance optimization.
    • Modern DevSecOps: Managing automated CI/CD code delivery pipelines, Docker/Kubernetes containerization, infrastructure-as-code, and live production deployments.
    • Secure Development Lifecycle: Implementing secure software development workflows, defensive coding patterns, payload encryption, and strict protection against vulnerabilities.
    • Localization & Multilingual Support: Building accessible application layers that natively support localization configurations, localized time/date formats, and multilingual engines (including Amharic script processing).
    • Production Platform Support: Active troubleshooting, root-cause anomaly analysis, log monitoring, and engineering support for active production environments.
    • Technical Governance: Compiling comprehensive technical documentation, conducting rigorous peer code reviews, and mentoring junior developers to foster engineering growth.

4.1.3 Position 1: Senior Full-Stack Engineer – Backend &    Systems Integration

A. Position Focus

This position serves as the core systems and backend architect of the sprint team, taking primary ownership of business logic execution, heavy data orchestration, and deep ecosystem integrations (e.g., Fayda National ID and central payment rails).

B. Targeted Technical Competencies

  • Advanced Backend Frameworks: Expert-level mastery building enterprise engines using Java (Spring Boot, Spring Security), asynchronous Node.js microservices, or Python (Django, FastAPI) with deep ORM tuning.
  • Database & Query Optimization: Verifiable experience configuring, indexing, and performance-tuning high-throughput relational engines (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and unstructured data layers (MongoDB).
  • High-Throughput Interoperability: Complete clarity constructing, securing, and orchestrating distributed RESTful, GraphQL, and gRPC endpoints across diverse legacy agency backends.

4.1.4 Position 2: Senior Full-Stack Engineer – Frontend & User Experience

A. Position Focus

This position bridges user requirements and hard engineering under the assumption of a separate UX/UI function. This engineer takes primary ownership of translating design mockups into high-performance, responsive code, focusing heavily on accessibility, multi-language support, and deployment across resource-constrained client devices.

B. Targeted Technical Competencies

5. Data Migration and Management

Where platform optimization and architectural refactoring involve structural changes to the core application architecture, underlying database schemas, or cloud hosting environments, the consultancy team shall take absolute technical responsibility for the secure preservation and transition of active production data.

To ensure complete continuity of government operations and to mitigate the risk of data loss or corruption, the consultants shall execute the following data migration mandates:

  • Comprehensive Approach Design: Formulate and document secure, end-to-end data migration methodologies, establishing clean structural mapping protocols between legacy storage layouts and targeted future-state data models.
  • Rigorous Validation & Cleansing: Implement automated data cleansing, format standardization, and validation workflows to eliminate anomalies, duplicate records, or data structural defects prior to executing data ingestion cycles.
  • Integrity & Reconciliation Auditing: Execute mandatory cryptographic integrity checks, automated checksum verifications, and thorough data reconciliation procedures to guarantee that zero information loss occurs during the transit window.
  • Fault-Tolerant Rollback Arrangements: Establish, test, and maintain robust, near-instantaneous rollback mechanisms and disaster recovery procedures to safely revert database environments to their exact pre-migration state in the event of an migration anomaly.
  • Strict Sovereignty & Privacy Compliance: Enforce unwavering compliance with all applicable national data protection frameworks and privacy requirements, ensuring that sensitive citizen attributes remain fully encrypted, masked, and audited throughout the entire migration pipeline.
